subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding subtraction as taking away from a group (within 20)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student removes virtual objects from a group one at a time and counts what remains
exercise.pictorial: Student crosses out pictured objects being taken away and counts the remainder
exercise.abstract: Student solves simple subtraction sentences within 20

misconception_flags: counts the objects removed instead of the objects remaining

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
